summary: Iteration 13 QA of Notification Center Phases 3+4 (Gmail inboxes + Meta social feed). Backend: 39/39 pytest cases pass in 5.45s covering all 6 Meta endpoints (status/connect/oauth-callback/feed/refresh/disconnect) + 3 Gmail endpoints (status/connect/messages) across owner/marketing/sales/crew role gates, plus alerts regression. Frontend: 4 role personas exercised end-to-end — every selector in the review-request matched exactly. Owner /settings shows both gmail-settings-card + meta-settings-card with setup instructions, redirect URIs, and all three Connect buttons DISABLED (as expected — GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET and META_APP_ID/SECRET are intentionally empty). Owner /notifications shows all 4 tabs (All/Email/Social/Alerts) with both email placeholders + email-setup-link, and both social placeholders + social-setup-link. Sales ghost: only email-placeholder-contact (no owner card, no setup link), NO Social tab; /settings redirects to /leads. Marketing ghost: Social tab renders FB+IG placeholders WITHOUT social-setup-link (owner-only), Email tab only contact placeholder. Crew ghost: nav-notifications absent, direct /notifications redirects to /today.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py meta module (L4911-5151): _meta_gate correctly restricts to ('owner','marketing'); redirect_uri only exposed to owner in /meta/status (verified). /meta/connect uses require_owner dep — sales/marketing/crew all 403.

server.py /meta/oauth/callback (L5078-5122): public_router route so it works pre-auth; no-params / bad-state / error-param all return 302/307 RedirectResponse (denied|expired), NEVER 401/500. Verified via 3 negative pytest cases.

server.py /meta/refresh (L5144): checks meta_tokens.find_one before polling — returns 404 'Facebook isn't connected yet.' cleanly instead of stacktracing on missing tokens. Marketing gets same 404 (proper 404 vs 403 semantics).
server.py meta_poll_loop (L5044-5050): silently no-ops if meta_tokens doc missing (returns 0). Confirmed via backend logs — no error spam in preview where no tokens exist.

server.py gmail_status (L4728-4742): filters mailboxes by role via GMAIL_MAILBOXES[mid]['roles'] before returning. Sales/marketing get only contact mailbox; redirect_uri exposed only to owner. Verified.
server.py _gmail_access_token (L4657-4659): raises HTTPException(409) 'That mailbox isn't connected yet.' when no token doc exists — clean 4xx, never 500. Verified.
server.py meta callback token encryption (L5106-5114): uses _gmail_fernet() (same Fernet key derived from JWT_SECRET) — good code reuse; both providers share the same key derivation.
Notifications.jsx L119-121: canSocial = owner || marketing correctly gates BOTH the TabsTrigger AND the TabsContent — sales ghost verified NOT to render notif-tab-social.
Notifications.jsx L183-186: email-setup-link wrapped in {isOwner && ...} — sales+marketing verified NOT to see the setup link even though they see the contact placeholder.
SocialFeed.jsx L69-73: social-setup-link wrapped in {isOwner && ...} — marketing verified NOT to see the setup link even though they see the placeholder cards. Correctly matches spec.
MetaCard.jsx L69-86 + L108-121: setup instructions + connect buttons both gated on !status.configured / disabled={!status.configured} respectively. Connect button confirmed disabled in DOM.
GmailCard.jsx L69-86 + L100-110: mirrors the same 'configured' gating pattern as MetaCard. Both connect buttons (contact + owner) verified disabled.
App.js routes for crew do not include /notifications — visiting the URL falls through to /today. Verified.

backend/.env: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, META_APP_ID, META_APP_SECRET all present but empty strings. Per handoff note, this is EXPECTED (user hasn't created cloud projects yet). Not flagged as a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI selector checks across owner + 3 ghost personas pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13_gmail_meta.py (39 tests, ~5.5s) covers: TestMetaStatus (4), TestMetaConnect (4), TestMetaFeed (4), TestMetaRefresh (4), TestMetaDisconnect (4), TestMetaOAuthCallback (3, tests public 302/307 redirects without auth), TestGmailStatus (4), TestGmailConnect (5), TestGmailMessages (3, ensures 409 not 500 on unconnected mailbox + 404 on sales accessing owner mailbox), TestAlertsRegression (4). All 4 role personas (owner/sales/marketing/crew) covered per endpoint. Iter12's suite (test_iteration12_alerts_webhooks.py) can be re-run for alerts+zapier regression — should still pass. Frontend selectors covered end-to-end this iteration: gmail-settings-card, gmail-setup-instructions, gmail-redirect-uri, gmail-connect-contact/owner (both disabled), meta-settings-card, meta-setup-instructions, meta-redirect-uri, meta-copy-uri-btn, meta-connect-btn (disabled); notification tab placeholders + role-gated setup links (email-setup-link owner-only, social-setup-link owner-only, notif-tab-social owner+marketing-only). Once main agent gets real GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET or META_APP_ID/SECRET from user, all disabled buttons will unlock and the /meta/connect + /gmail/connect endpoints will return 200 auth_urls instead of 422.

rca of the issue: No issues found. All acceptance criteria in the review-request met exactly. The four intentionally-empty env vars (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, META_APP_ID/SECRET) produce the correct 'configured:false + disabled buttons + 422 on connect' user-facing state — this is BY DESIGN per the agent handoff note ('user has no Google or Meta credentials yet, both integrations are in not-configured / not-connected state'). One minor observation (informational, not a bug): the 401 CONSOLE_ERR spam during login is from the AuthGate probing /api/auth/me before the token is set — normal SPA behavior, harmless.
